crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, work on assigned tasks.

crons.name: pipeline-scan
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {06,07,08}, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/pipeline-scan-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: scan the configured CRM for active deals. Score each by stage + age + last touch. Drop summary to data/brew/$(date +%F)-pipeline.md so Avery can pull it for the morning brew. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.

crons.name: comps-refresh
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%A. If output is not Monday, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/comps-refresh-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: refresh comps for active listings. Flag any pricing drift greater than 5% from list. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.

crons.name: deadline-calc
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {08,20}, exit silently. Otherwise: for every active deal, recalc subject removal / deposit / possession dates. Surface anything tight (<48h) to Avery via send-message normal.

crons.name: auto-commit
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {21,22,23}, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/auto-commit-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: read .claude/skills/local-version-control/SKILL.md and execute the daily version control workflow. Stage, review, and commit changes. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.
